subject: Billing routing & VAT stewardship during Northpoint entity rename
messages:
From: Oliver Harris <oliver.harris@northpoint.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance.ops@northpoint.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate: billing address + VAT handling for Northpoint legal rename

Hi Hannah / Monica,

Hope you’re both well. As we move toward the closing date (targeted July 1), our treasury team flagged potential gaps in how invoices will be routed once Northpoint consolidates multiple subsidiaries under the new legal name. Specific asks:

- Can Redwood continue sending invoices to our existing AP inbox for 90 days post-close, or do we need to update billing address on day one?
- VAT registration: Northpoint is consolidating EU entities and will move invoicing under a single VAT ID in Q3. Do you need a formal certificate or will a signed attestation suffice for your tax team?
- Bank/account authorizations: we may need to change remit-to banking info and provide an authorization letter for moving payments.

Attaching the acquisition playbook excerpt and team contacts. Would love a quick playbook / checklist from Redwood so our procurement and treasury teams know what to expect.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Harris
Head of Finance Integration | Northpoint Systems
[attachment: NP-Acq-Playbook-Excerpt.pdf]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Harris <oliver.harris@northpoint.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate: billing address + VAT handling for Northpoint legal rename

Hi Oliver — thanks for the context and the playbook excerpt. Quick answers up front:

- We can keep routing invoices to your current AP inbox for a 90-day grace period post-close, provided we have a documented mailbox-forwarding/owner on your side. After that, we will switch to the new remit instructions you provide.
- For VAT consolidation, we require either (a) the EU VAT registration certificate for the new entity, or (b) a signed letter from your tax lead plus the target VAT ID, plus a compliant accounting contact. An attestation is OK for short-term operations but we’ll need the certificate before we update VAT tax tags permanently.
- Bank remits: we need a signed bank authorization PDF (signed by an authorized signatory) and a short KYC for the receiving account if the routing account is new.

I’m drafting a one-page cutover playbook and a CSV invoice-routing template (fields: legacy_entity, new_entity, remit_email, remit_bank_name, ibAN/SWIFT, vat_id, effective_date, notes). I’ll share it in the next message.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Global Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Harris <oliver.harris@northpoint.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: billing address + VAT handling for Northpoint legal rename

Oliver — adding a couple of operational points from collections and billing:

- Please confirm who will be the accounting contact for dispute/PO reconciliation after cutover. We recommend a 1:1 technical contact for 60 days to avoid missed payments.
- For early invoices issued under the old entity but paid into the new bank account, please include both legacy and new entity names on the invoice header during the 90-day window. That prevents bank reconciliation issues.
- If you expect mass remapping of billing codes (PO numbers mapped to new cost centers), send sample PO mappings so we can validate our AR ingest mapping.

I’ve attached our CSV template (NP-Invoice-Routing-Template.csv) — please populate one row per legacy entity and return. Also attaching the bank authorization stub we need signed (Northpoint-Bank-Authorizations.pdf).

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

- Effective date for remit change: 2027-07-15 (we’ll keep the 90-day invoice-forwarding window in place starting 2027-07-01).
- VAT certificate: we expect to have consolidated VAT ID live by 2027-09-01; attached is an interim attestation signed by our Tax Director. We’ll send the certificate when available.
- PO mapping: attached separate file (PO-mapping-sample.csv). That should be enough to validate ingest.

Let us know if Redwood needs any additional notarized authorizations for wire setup.

Oliver

Thanks — received and reviewed the templates. Final checklist for execution: 

1) Redwood will maintain invoice delivery to Finance Ops inbox (finance.ops@northpoint.com) from 2027-07-01 through 2027-09-28. We will add a migration header to invoices during that window: 
   - Invoice header: "Issued by [legacy entity] for account of Northpoint Systems (new legal name)"
2) Monica to update AR ingest with the provided PO-mapping-sample.csv and validate against 5 sample invoices the week of 2027-07-12.
3) Treasury: provide signed bank authorization and a short KYC PDF for the receiving account (we received the signed stub — if treasury can confirm the notarization status, share it to DocuSign envelope above).
4) VAT: We will tag transactions with the interim VAT attestation for reporting; once you provide the formal certificate (expected by 2027-09-01) we will perform a one-time VAT tag migration and send a reconciliation report.

I’ve uploaded the final invoice-routing template to the Drive folder (link above) and triggered DocuSign for the bank authorization records. Aditya — can you confirm the internal ticket to schedule the AR validation sweep? Marcus — please standby to approve any GL-mapping exceptions.

Best,
Hannah
